title: Supplemental Methods for Sonographic B-lines and Fluid Resuscitation in Malawian Patients
author: Richard J Wang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdqsi5we

steps.title: Configure Ultrasound Equipment
steps.instruction: Set up the ultrasound system using the specified hardware and software parameters.

substeps.instruction: Pair an S4-1 Lumify phased array transducer (Phillips NV, Amsterdam, Netherlands) with a Samsung Galaxy Tab S3 SM-T820NZKA (Samsung Electronics, Seoul, Korea).

steps.title: Position Patient and Define Zones
steps.instruction: Position the participant and partition the chest wall into 8 zones based on Volpicelli et al. guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Place the participant in a supine position with arms abducted.
Delineate the anterior chest wall from the sternum to the anterior axillary line, subdividing it into superior and inferior zones at the level of the third or fourth inter-costal space.
Delineate the lateral chest wall from the anterior to the posterior axillary line, subdividing it into superior and inferior zones at the level of the fourth or fifth inter-costal space.

steps.title: Acquire Lung Ultrasound Images
steps.instruction: Perform eight-point lung ultrasonography at enrollment and subsequently at 3, 6, 24, 48, and 72 hours.

substeps.instruction: Apply the transducer in sagittal orientation for anterior zones and coronal orientation for lateral zones.
Position the transducer overlying an inter-costal space so that both ribs are visible simultaneously.
Record four-second clips at each quadrant of the hemi-thorax (total of eight clips per exam).

steps.title: Analyze Images and Calculate B-line Score
steps.instruction: Review clips offline to count B-lines and generate a total B-line score for each exam.

substeps.instruction: Review each clip and count the maximal number of discrete B-lines visualized in a single frame.
Do not measure the distance between discrete B-lines to determine if they are contiguous or coalescent.
Assign a value of zero B-lines if a pleural effusion or consolidation is observed.
Assign a value of 1 B-line if artifacts appear confluent throughout the clip and separate, discrete B-lines cannot be distinguished in any frame.
Sum the number of B-lines from all clips to generate the final B-line score.
